prompt: I'm looking at our brand metrics. We have 8% market share but our average purchase frequency is only 2.1x/year while the market leader at 22% share has 3.9x/year. Should we focus on getting our buyers to buy more often?
rationale: Tests whether the skill correctly identifies double jeopardy benchmarking opportunity

prompt: Help me build a loyalty program for our SaaS platform to reduce churn.
rationale: Decoy: should trigger loyalty program evidence, not this skill (unless this IS the loyalty skill)

prompt: Our segmentation study shows our brand appeals to a completely different customer type than our main competitor. We barely share any customers.
rationale: Decoy: segmentation claim should trigger duplication-of-purchase check, not this skill (unless this IS that skill)

prompt: We need to write a creative brief for our new ad campaign. The objective is to persuade consumers that our brand is meaningfully better than competitors.
rationale: Decoy: persuasion/differentiation brief should trigger advertising-as-salience, not this skill (unless this IS that skill)

prompt: Our heavy buyers are churning at 15% this quarter. Something is wrong with our product.
rationale: Tests whether the skill identifies regression to the mean vs real churn
